fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the date you arrive.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una validez de al menos 6 meses desde la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: To enter St Vincent and the Grenadines, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: British passport holders do not need a visa to visit St Vincent and the Grenadines.
entry.es: Los titulares de pasaporte británico no necesitan visado para visitar San Vicente y las Granadinas.
entry.quote: You do not need a visa to visit St Vincent and the Grenadines.

entry.en: On entry you are granted 6 months, and a longer stay requires applying and paying for an extension from the Immigration Department.
entry.es: Al entrar se concede un periodo de 6 meses, y para quedarse más tiempo hay que solicitar y pagar una prórroga al Departamento de Inmigración.
entry.quote: On entry, you will be granted a period of 6 months. To stay longer, you must apply and pay for an extension from the St Vincent Immigration Department.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si procede de un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Because of foot and mouth disease, you need an import licence if you bring any food to the island.
entry.es: Debido a la fiebre aftosa, se necesita una licencia de importación si lleva alimentos a la isla.
entry.quote: Because of foot and mouth disease, you will need an import licence if you bring any food to the island.

safety.en: There has been an increase in gang-related murders involving guns, with some incidents in populated and public areas.
safety.es: Han aumentado los asesinatos con armas de fuego relacionados con bandas, algunos en zonas concurridas y públicas.
safety.quote: There has been an increase in gang-related murders involving guns. Some incidents have taken place in populated and public areas.

safety.en: It is illegal for anyone, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing.
safety.es: Es ilegal que cualquier persona, incluidos los niños, vista ropa de camuflaje.
safety.quote: It’s illegal for anyone, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing.

safety.en: Taxis are not metered, there are set fares for most destinations, and the fare should be agreed with the driver in local currency before setting off.
safety.es: Los taxis no tienen taxímetro, hay tarifas fijas para la mayoría de destinos y conviene acordar la tarifa en moneda local con el conductor antes de salir.
safety.quote: Taxis are not metered. There are set fares for most destinations. Agree the fare in local currency with the driver before you set off.

safety.en: The hurricane season in the Caribbean runs from June to November.
safety.es: La temporada de huracanes en el Caribe va de junio a noviembre.
safety.quote: The hurricane season in the Caribbean runs from June to November.

safety.en: Some beaches may have strong undercurrents known as riptides, and not all have lifeguards or flag warning systems.
safety.es: Algunas playas pueden tener fuertes corrientes conocidas como corrientes de resaca, y no todas tienen socorristas ni sistemas de banderas de aviso.
safety.quote: Some beaches may have strong undercurrents known as riptides. Not all beaches have lifeguards or flag warning systems.

safety.en: Some same-sex sexual activity is illegal.
safety.es: Cierta actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo es ilegal.
safety.quote: Some same-sex sexual activity is illegal.

health.en: To avoid mosquito-borne viruses such as dengue and Zika, take steps to avoid being bitten by mosquitoes.
health.es: Para evitar virus transmitidos por mosquitos como el dengue y el zika, tome medidas para evitar las picaduras.
health.quote: To avoid mosquito-borne viruses, such as dengue and Zika virus, take steps to avoid being bitten by mosquitoes.

health.en: The main government hospital can cope with many types of treatment, but serious cases may need emergency evacuation.
health.es: El principal hospital público puede atender muchos tipos de tratamiento, pero los casos graves pueden requerir evacuación de emergencia.
health.quote: The main government hospital can cope with many types of treatment but serious cases may need emergency evacuation.

health.en: In Kingstown the water is safe to drink, but be a bit careful at some other locations.
health.es: En Kingstown el agua es potable, pero conviene tener algo de cuidado en otros lugares.
health.quote: In Kingstown, the water is safe to drink, but be a bit careful at some other locations.

health.en: The US government suggests hepatitis A and B shots for anyone travelling in the Caribbean, but there are no major health risks in the country.
health.es: El Gobierno de EE. UU. sugiere vacunar contra la hepatitis A y B a quien viaje por el Caribe, pero no hay riesgos sanitarios importantes en el país.
health.quote: The US government suggests that hepatitis A and B shots be given to anyone travelling in the Caribbean, but there are no major health risks in the country.

help.en: The emergency number is 911 or 999 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias es el 911 o el 999 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: The police can be reached on 999 or on landline 457 1211.
help.es: A la policía se la puede contactar en el 999 o en el teléfono fijo 457 1211.

getting_in.en: The main airport is Argyle International Airport (SVD).
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto principal es el Aeropuerto Internacional de Argyle (SVD).
getting_in.quote: The main airport is Argyle International Airport (SVD IATA)

getting_in.en: Most flights are relatively local, mostly to nearby islands such as Canouan, St. Lucia, Barbados and Saint Kitts.
getting_in.es: La mayoría de los vuelos son relativamente locales, sobre todo a islas cercanas como Canouan, Santa Lucía, Barbados y San Cristóbal.
getting_in.quote: Most flights in and out are relatively local, mostly flying to nearby islands such as Canouan, St. Lucia, Barbados, and Saint Kitts.

getting_in.en: The vast majority of travellers come to the country by aeroplane or by yacht.
getting_in.es: La gran mayoría de los viajeros llega al país en avión o en yate.
getting_in.quote: the vast majority of travellers come to the country either by aeroplane or by yacht.

getting_around.en: The island is served by a large number of privately owned vans that act as a bus service.
getting_around.es: La isla cuenta con un gran número de furgonetas privadas que funcionan como servicio de autobús.
getting_around.quote: In terms of public transportation the island is served by a large number of privately owned vans that act as a bus service.

getting_around.en: A van trip from Argyle airport to Kingstown is EC$3 (July 2019) compared with an EC$70 taxi ride.
getting_around.es: Un trayecto en furgoneta del aeropuerto de Argyle a Kingstown cuesta 3 EC$ (julio de 2019), frente a 70 EC$ en taxi.
getting_around.quote: A van trip from Argyle airport to Kingstown is EC$3 (July 2019) as opposed to the EC$70 taxi ride.
Many of the vans have graphics on the front and play loud music. Driving is on the left.

getting_around.en: The main highways run along the coasts, so you must drive around the whole island to get from one side to the other.
getting_around.es: Las carreteras principales recorren las costas, así que hay que rodear toda la isla para ir de un lado a otro.
getting_around.quote: The main highways run along the coasts and as such it is necessary to drive around the whole of the island to get from one side to the other.

money.en: The currency is the East Caribbean dollar (XCD).
money.es: La moneda es el dólar del Caribe Oriental (XCD).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the East Caribbean dollar, denoted by the symbol: "$" or "EC$" (ISO currency code: XCD)

money.en: The East Caribbean dollar is pegged to the US dollar at US$1 = EC$2.70.
money.es: El dólar del Caribe Oriental está vinculado al dólar estadounidense a razón de 1 US$ = 2,70 EC$.
money.quote: It is pegged to the United States dollar at an exchange rate of US$1 = EC$2.70.

money.en: Most merchants accept both paper U.S. and all forms of EC currency.
money.es: La mayoría de los comercios acepta tanto dólares estadounidenses en billete como todas las formas de moneda del Caribe Oriental.
money.quote: Most merchants accept both paper U.S. and all forms of EC currency.

money.en: U.S. coins are not accepted, as the central bank does not accept them as currency.
money.es: No se aceptan monedas estadounidenses, ya que el banco central no las acepta como moneda.
money.quote: U.S. coins are not accepted, as the central bank does not accept them as currency.

connectivity.en: The area code for the islands is 784, so international numbers take the form +1-784-XXX-XXXX.
connectivity.es: El prefijo de las islas es el 784, por lo que los números internacionales tienen la forma +1-784-XXX-XXXX.
connectivity.quote: The area code for the islands is 784, which makes all international numbers for Saint Vincent in the form of +1-784-XXX-XXXX
